# Annual (June) O(1) rebel-guarded fallback pulse for Slot 83 (oe_msn_).
# Deduplicated per calendar month via global_var:oe_msn_ran_m ?= oe_ml_month_now so BYZ never double-ticks.
monthly_country_pulse = {
	on_actions = { oe_msn_fallback_pulse }
}

oe_msn_fallback_pulse = {
	trigger = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { global_var:oe_msn_ran_m ?= oe_ml_month_now }
		OR = {
			current_month = 6
			NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_msn_init }
		}
		OR = {
			AND = { tag = BYZ is_rebel_country = no }
			AND = { NOT = { country_exists = c:BYZ } is_ai = no }
			AND = { NOT = { country_exists = c:BYZ } tag = TUR }
			AND = { NOT = { country_exists = c:BYZ } NOT = { country_exists = c:TUR } tag = CHI }
		}
	}
	effect = {
		oe_ml_mark_start = yes
		if = {
			limit = { oe_start_is_1337 = yes }
			oe_msn_monthly = yes
		}
	}
}
